findings.evidence: MainActivity uses MediaController to bind to PlaybackService locally. MaveFunctions uses text for AI vibe generation, no music files are transferred. No off-device transmission of user music files was found.
findings.recommendation: Maintain local-only processing for user music files.

findings.evidence: MainActivity receives user credentials (e.g. from GoogleSignIn, Apple SignIn, Verified Email) and passes them to the viewModel for first-party Firebase authentication. DeleteAccountScreen allows the user to delete their account.
findings.recommendation: Ensure user account collection is declared in the Play Store Data Safety form.
